Description: Tiny holes made by beetle larvae once ran throughout the staff, but are now sealed with a hardened layer of resin.
Left behind by Melril, a Pact soldier, after you swore to avenge his death at the hands of Reach tribes.

Item Name: Armor fit for the hero who aided soldiers at Boulderfall Pass against a Reachman attack. From Captain Jardirr herself.
Unlucky Yngrel's Axe of the Witchman
Rozelun's Leathery Hide of the Witchman

Description: One of Vigrod's prized vests. Now yours after the two of you took back the Rift from the Reach.

Item Name: Svari, now a sage, gifted you her staff after you accompanied her to Fallowstone's shrines.

Description: For one who walked above the clouds at Forelhost and recovered a shard of Ysgramor's axe Wuuthrad.

Item Name: Battered War Trophy of Draugr Heritage

Description: You earned this reliable war belt by investigating the murders on Frostmoon Farmstead.
This legendary weapon once belonged to Unnvald, Fullhelm's thane.

Item Name: Longstride's Drinking Cup of Draugr Heritage

Description: After you impressed the Nords of Geirmund's Hall with your mead tolerance and song, they knew these boots would fit you nicely.

Item Name: Awarded for rescuing the foolish bards who landed themselves in a giant's camp.

Description: Awarded for trudging across the battlefield to bandage Pact soldiers injured while fighting the Worm Cult.
You made away with this mighty cudgel after slaying the so-called Goblin Nilwen asked you to find.

Item Name: This pendant is a parting gift from Odvild for saving her husband with a frostflower you plucked.

Description: Given with gratitude by Thane Viri for returning the belongings of the Worm Cult's victims at Lost Prospect.

Item Name: Heavy yet tough. A reward from Captain Viveka for rescuing her squad from Gullveig's necromantic ritual.

Description: A remnant of a dispute over stolen silk between two deceptive Dark Elf merchants.

Item Name: Fashioned for a true guard of the Thane after you protected her against Worm Cultists.

Description: A beautiful dagger from Tovisa, given in thanks for killing the Hagravens who stole her sight.

Item Name: Despite losing her sight, Tovisa thanked you with this ring for helping her investigate a Reach camp.
A trophy of your victory over Yngrel the Bloody, taken after you confronted him at Northwind Mine.

Description: Hakra thanked you for freeing her from the Worm Cult with these greaves. Spirits like her won't need them.
A wintry staff that will send any Worm Cultist running, just like they did when you drove them out of Riften.

Item Name: The staff's name and lineage had once been etched upon the staff. Now, the barest trace of its name is all that remains.
Received after solving the difficult situation between Sarisa and Bar-Neeus, merchants in Riften.
With his runaway target killed, Deadeye felt grateful enough to thank you with one of his blades.

Description: Vigrod bestowed these greaves after you uncovered the Reach shaman ritual in the Companion tomb.

Item Name: The ring's opalescent surface appears to change with your every movement.
You earned this Nord axe by scouring the mines at Shor's Stone and freeing miners from the Reach's grasp.
Sneaky and quiet. A gift from Aera Earth-Turner for helping kill her Worm Cult targets.

Description: Gifted by Engling for taking back Skald's Retreat from Vaermina's Daedric realm.

Item Name: Overjoyed to see his lost tomes returned, Loremaster Bragur paid you with this ring.

Description: For saving those left of his fallen companions, Snorrvild rewarded you with these shoulder pieces.
Free from the Worm Cult's chains, Valdur's spirit bestowed his shield on you and promised his aid.
Built to endure. Your reward for quelling the Worm Cult and Giants at Treva's Farm.

Item Name: Left behind by Grandfather Treva for freeing him and his farmhands' spirits from the Worm Cult.

Description: A necklace from King Jorunn that honors your efforts in clearing Trolhetta Cave of the Worm Cult.

Item Name: Sturdy shoulder pieces designed for maximum protection. Awarded for recovering the amulets of the fallen in Trolhetta Cave.

Description: This sturdy mace commemorates the newly forged bond amongst the Nords, Elves, and Argonians.
After you gathered Graveborn hearts to research their rituals, Belron thanked you with this reliable ring.

Item Name: The sturdy axe was obtained during the battles with the Graveborn.
